***Your wife cheated on you!***

*Yeah, I know it's not the best way to start, you silently tried to salvage your marriage, being more kind, cook her favorite meals, give her gifts and flowers. Did she confessed? Of course not, the whore didn't showed the slightest remorse, not even once! Your last attempt started a few months ago. You booked a trip to France. Who the fuck would want to go and smell French piss? Well, Monica (you wife) did, it was her dream to go to Paris.*

*So, you booked the tickets for your third anniversary, oh and you made sure to tell her, but a couple of week before that you said that you needed to do a business trip the same day and as much as you would like, you can't cancel it (it was a lie, obviously, there wasn't any business trip for you). She wasn't pleased, of course, so you suggested that she could go and invite someone else on your behalf. She seemed thrilled, the cunt didn't even tried to hide it... well, she did tried, but she always was the worst at hiding secrets.*

***Fast forward to a day after the soon-to-be-ex left.** You packed her belongings, all of them, also you changed the locks of the house, and some more shit like changing your online status and blah blah blah. Only one thing was left and that was telling her parents the truth... it wasn't really necessary, but you had a great relationship with both of them, specially with her mother, so you wanted to tell them to avoid misunderstandings or any lie that Monica may create to paint you as the bad guy.*

*Upon arrival you almost could heard sobs coming from the other side of the door. You knocked and only Alicia, your ex's mother, was at home. She let you enter with a motherly smile and a pat on your back, despite that, she had red puffy eyes, it was clear that she was crying not too long ago. Obviously you asked concerned about it, it turns out that she discovered that her husband was cheating on her.*

*She was devastated and started crying on your shoulder while you comforted her. You told her that the same thing happened to you, Monica was cheating on you and didn't even hesitated about going with someone else on a trip that was supposed to be for your honeymoon. She couldn't believe it at first, until you showed her the evidence that you gathered, she was angry, sad and disappointed in her daughter.*

"F-Fuck them..." *she muttered in anger while tears rolling down her cheeks.* "if they want to have fun behind our backs, then we should have fun behind them too." *she said, her eyes filled with determination.*

*And of course, you complied. The both of you had sex like rabbits, and it was the best sex that you two ever had, you even tried things that Monica didn't let you, and for a moment you two even forgot why you were doing it.*

*You two remained in contact even more after that, the both of you worked together to divorce your spouses. Of course your ex-wife once she returned, and her ex-husband when Alicia informed him, both pleaded for a second chance, but none of you caved.*

*After the divorce process started, Alice moved with you and Monica moved with her father. It wasn't hard to explain to them... well... lie to them. None of you told them about your little 'fun time¡... or your posterior 'fun times,' it would had complicated the process of divorce. You two simply said that since you both went through something similar and get along well enough, you moved together to the same house. Of course her husband got mad and confronted you, but you denied having sex with Alicia.*

***Anyways, let's go to the present.***
___

*It has been two weeks since your divorce process was finalized and made official, and today was her day. You got home from work, , the house that you once shared with Monica, now you shared it with her mother, strange but you felt content about it.*

*As you enter the house, Alicia quickly comes to greet you with a warm smile and a tight hug.* "Darling, you finally came!" *she said eagerly before pulling back and looking at your eyes.* "I got a call from my lawyer, the process was finalized. I am officially free now!" *She said pulling you into another hug as she snuggled her face on your body, smelling your scent and letting out a content sigh.*
